Name: Low Hedge Fence
Author: aaphra
Description:
[center][color=#6aa176][u][b][size=6]Low Hedge Fence and Gate[/size][/b][/u][/color]

[b][size=5] Add a new low-profile hedge fence to your farm! Comes with seasonal variations. [/size][/b]
Fence is shorter than the wooden and iron fences and close in height to the stone fence. Should blend well with existing fence types. There are [color=#e0bb7e][b]three versions[/b][/color] available: one for [color=#ba914e][b]Alternative Textures[/b][/color], which allows you to recolor individual fences of any kind. One for [color=#ba914e][b]Content Patcher[/b][/color], which will replace an entire type of fencing with the hedge. And one for [color=#ba914e][b]JSON Assets[/b][/color] which adds the spring and summer variants as entirely new craftable objects. All versions are compatible with each other.

Seasonal variations include: Default seasonal variation which matches the flora in game. Evergreen variations for green bushes year-round. Flowering variant where both Spring and Summer hedges have flowers. Snowcapped version where winter hedges have a dusting of snow. Alternative texture users may switch between these variations at anytime.


[color=#ed91b9][u][b][size=5]Alternative Textures Version - SDV 1.6+ [/size][/b][/u][/color][/center][color=#c72c6a][b]Requirements:[/b][/color] SMAPI (4.0.1+), Alternative Textures (7.1.2+)
[color=#c72c6a][b]Usage:[/b][/color] Use the paint bucket, paint brush, or spray can to change the fence textures. Colors will change by season automatically.
[color=#c72c6a][b]Installation:[/b][/color] Unzip and place into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[color=#ff0000][b]NOTE: Sometimes the texture files apply misaligned and look wrong. Changing seasons back and forth or saving, exiting, and restarting the game will fix them.[/b][/color]
I believe this is an issue with AT and will look into it.


[center][color=#ed91b9][u][b][size=5]Content Patcher Version - SDV 1.6+ [/size][/b][/u][/color][/center][color=#c72c6a][b]Requirements:[/b][/color] SMAPI (4.0.1+), Content Patcher (2.0.1+), Generic Mod Config Menu (1.12.0+)
[color=#c72c6a][b]Usage:[/b][/color] Using GMCM, select which fence you would like to replace. Fence1 is the Wood Fence, Fence2 is the Stone Fence, Fence3 is the Iron Fence, and Fence 4 is the Hardwood Fence. Colors will change by season automatically.
[color=#c72c6a][b]Installation:[/b][/color] Unzip and place [b][u]ONE[/u][/b] variation folder into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[color=#c72c6a][b]Compatibility:[/b][/color] Will not work with other CP mods that alter the same fence.


[center][color=#ed91b9][u][b][size=5]JSON Assets Version - SDV 1.5 [/size][/b][/u][/color][/center][color=#c72c6a][b]Requirements:[/b][/color] SMAPI (3.18.3+), JSON Assets (1.10.13+) and all its requirements
[color=#c72c6a][b]Usage:[/b][/color] Crafting recipes for the spring and summer hedges should be unlocked by default and cost 2 Fiber per fence. Hedges will not change by season.
[color=#c72c6a][b]Installation:[/b][/color] Unzip and place into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
